name: kebunsah-seed
description: KebunSah 模拟数据：200 个虚构地块，Firestore 形状的 JSON

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it kebunsah-pg psql -U kebunsah -d kebunsah
scripts.db:check: docker exec -i kebunsah-pg psql -U kebunsah -d kebunsah -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/check.sql
